 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Humayun Shah (1458 – 1461 CE) was a important Ruler of Bahmani Kingdom**
 
• He succeeded to the throne following the death of his father, **Alauddin Ahmad II**..
 
• He appointed **Khwaja Mahmud Gawan **as **Prime Minister**, granting him authority over military matters.
 
• Humayun was known for his **harsh temperament**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Bahmani Kingdom was established by Hasan Gangu Bahmani.**
 
• He laid the foundation for a first independent Muslim State of Deccan in the southern provinces of India.
 
• The Bahmani Kingdom started growing after the successful revolt against Muhammad-Bin-Tughlaq in 1327 A.D.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Maharashtra became the part of Bahmani Kingdom.**
 
• The official language was Persian, though the use of local languages, such as Urdu, Deccani, Marathi, Telugu and Kannada were common.
 
• The Bahmani kingdom declined and were divided into the following successor kingdoms under different rulers.
 
 
• **The Adilshahis of Bijapur (1490-1686 A.D.)**
 
• **The Nizam Shahis of Ahmednagar (1490-1633 A.D.)**
 
• **The Qutub Shahis of Golconda (1518-1687 A.D.)**
 
• **The Imadshahis of Berar (1490-1574 A.D.)**
 
• **The Baridshahis of Bidar (1528-1619 A.D.)**
